definitions.explanation: A six-sided polygon. Used in mathematics, and as a description for honeycomb cells, nuts and bolt heads, snowflake patterns, and other six-sided objects.

examples.japanese: {六角形|ろっかくけい}を{描|か}く。
ハチの{巣|す}は{六角形|ろっかくけい}でできている。
examples.english: A beehive is made of hexagons.

examples.japanese: {正|せい}{六角形|ろっかくけい}の{内角|ないかく}の{和|わ}は{七百二十度|ななひゃくにじゅうど}になる。
examples.english: The interior angles of a regular hexagon add up to seven hundred twenty degrees.

notes:
Compound of {六|ろく} (six) + {角|かく} (angle / corner) + {形|けい} (shape). The reading is ろっかくけい — the second consonant doubles via sokuon. Also sometimes pronounced ろっかっけい in speech, but ろっかくけい is the standard reading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正|せい}{六角形|ろっかくけい}: regular hexagon (all sides and angles equal)
- {六角形|ろっかくけい}の{形|かたち}: hexagonal shape
- ハチの{巣|す}{構造|こうぞう}: honeycomb structure (six-sided)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {三角形|さんかくけい}: triangle
- {四角形|しかくけい}: quadrilateral
- {五角形|ごかくけい}: pentagon
- {多角形|たかっけい}: polygon (general)
